text: The meeting identified action items to deliver a written project plan by the next meeting.
The industrial designer (FIE073) is tasked with delivering a written project plan within two weeks, detailing functional and technical design, required contributors, timeline, and initial budget.
A joint plan will be developed that includes cost and a market strategy to compete.
The product scope was decided as a remote control for television with a user-friendly design.
Market/competitor research will be conducted, and Ed will be kept informed by copying discussions and documents.
